title: Sum numbers with a loop
instruction: Given the list `nums`, use a `for` loop to calculate the sum of all numbers. Print the total.
starter_code:
nums = [12, 7, 9, 22, 15]
# Calculate and print the sum
solution_code:
nums = [12, 7, 9, 22, 15]
total = 0
for n in nums:
    total += n
print(total)

title: Build a grocery list
instruction: Start with an empty list called `grocery_list`. Use `.append()` to add "milk", "bread", "eggs", and "apples". Then use a `for` loop with `enumerate()` to print each item with its index number (starting from 1, not 0).
starter_code: # Build a grocery list and print with numbered items
solution_code:
grocery_list = []
grocery_list.append("milk")
grocery_list.append("bread")
grocery_list.append("eggs")
grocery_list.append("apples")
for i, item in enumerate(grocery_list):
    print(f"{i+1}. {item}")
